title: Standard
subtitle: 「標準／水平／基準／常態／品質／典型」，究竟是哪一種 standard？
description: 「標準／水平／基準／常態／品質／典型」，究竟是哪一種 standard？

words.note: 表示表現、技能、服務或品質所達到的高低程度。
words.example: The level of service is very high.

exercises.original: The standard of spoken English in the class is very high.
exercises.zh: 這班學生的英語口語水平很高。
exercises.upgrade: level · 水平；程度；標準水平

options.explanation: spoken English + very high 表示能力程度。
benchmark 主要表示「比較參照點」。但本題具體線索是 degree of language ability，需要表達「程度高低」；因此 benchmark 雖然相關，並不是這句的最佳答案。
norm 主要表示「普遍常態／慣例」。但本題具體線索是 degree of language ability，需要表達「程度高低」；因此 norm 雖然相關，並不是這句的最佳答案。
quality 主要表示「事物好壞」。但本題具體線索是 degree of language ability，需要表達「程度高低」；因此 quality 雖然相關，並不是這句的最佳答案。

falseSynonyms.zh: level 表示程度高低；standard 還可表示要求、基準或規範。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The service is at a high level. The safety standard is legally required.

falseSynonyms.zh: benchmark 一定有 comparison/reference function；standard 可以只是最低要求。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The national average is used as a benchmark. The product meets the required standard.

falseSynonyms.zh: norm 表示通常做法或社會慣例；standard 可以是正式規格。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Remote work has become the norm. The equipment must meet the safety standard.

falseSynonyms.zh: quality 是事物好壞；standard 可是衡量品質的要求。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The quality of the food is excellent. The restaurant follows hygiene standards.

falseSynonyms.zh: criterion 是單一判斷準則；standard 可以是一整套要求。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cost is one selection criterion. The school must maintain academic standards.

falseSynonyms.zh: specification 是精確技術要求；一般 academic/social standard 不一定是 specification。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The part meets the design specification. The school has high academic standards.

falseSynonyms.zh: baseline 是起始比較值；standard 可以是目標要求或外部 benchmark。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The first survey provides a baseline. The firm aims to meet the industry standard.

falseSynonyms.zh: standard 通常是名詞／形容詞；standardise 是動詞，表示使格式或做法一致。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The standard applies to all branches. The company standardised its reporting format.
